Last step of the ERM/GeoFrame water budget workflow: runs the water budget model with a given set of parameters, usually the ones found by the calibration, and shows the simulated against the observed discharge, with their Kling-Gupta efficiency.

**Toolbox folder:** GeoFrame<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** ERM, GeoFrame, simulation, water budget<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.hmachine.geoframe.ermworkflow.ErmSimulation`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inGeopackagePath` | vector file |  |  | The GeoFrame database, with all the inputs prepared by the previous steps of the workflow. |
| `inFromTimestamp` | String |  |  | Start of the simulated period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, in UTC. |
| `inToTimestamp` | String |  |  | End of the simulated period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, in UTC. |
| `pTimeStepMinutes` | int | min | `60` | Length of the time step: 60 for hourly data, 1440 for daily data. |
| `pSpinUpDays` | int | days | `365` | Days at the start of the period used only to warm up the model storages, excluded from the evaluation against the observations. |
| `doWriteState` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, model state is written to the database at each time step. |
| `inParams` | double[] |  |  | The 18 model parameters, in the order reported by the calibration. |

**References**

- Gupta, H. V., Kling, H., Yilmaz, K. K., Martinez, G. F. (2009). Decomposition of the mean squared error and NSE performance criteria: implications for improving hydrological modelling. Journal of Hydrology, 377(1-2), 80-91.
